info.long_name: Value of the demographic measure identified by measure
info.short_description: Value for the measure identified by the `measure` column. Units differ by measure: `acs_POP*` and `pep_population` are person counts, `acs_PCT_*` and `pep_pct_*` are proportions (0-1), `acs_AGE` is years, `acs_VAL` is dollars, and `acs_DEP`/`acs_REX` are ratios/index values.
info.long_description: Value for the measure identified by the `measure` column, taken unchanged from the census standard file (see each level's source documentation for definition and unit). Rows with missing values are dropped, so counties where a small-population estimate could not be computed have fewer rows than the full geography x year grid. Note that `acs_VAL` (median home value) is nominal dollars and not inflation-adjusted. The `acs_PCT_*` sex shares and age-band shares each sum to exactly 1 within a geography-year, but the seven race/ethnicity shares sum to slightly less (median 0.999, as low as 0.88) because non-Hispanic 'some other race alone' has no category of its own — do not treat the race shares as a complete partition. ACS and PEP shares are not interchangeable either: the two programs use different methodologies and race/ethnicity classifications, which is why `source` distinguishes them rather than the two being reconciled.

info.short_description: Census program the row's value came from. ACS 5-Year and PEP measure overlapping concepts with different methodologies and are reported side by side rather than reconciled.

info.long_name: Value of the demographic measure identified by measure
info.short_description: Value for the measure identified by the `measure` column. Units differ by measure: `acs_POP*` and `pep_population` are person counts, `acs_PCT_*` and `pep_pct_*` are proportions (0-1), `acs_AGE` is years, `acs_VAL` is dollars, and `acs_DEP`/`acs_REX` are ratios/index values.
info.long_description: Value for the measure identified by the `measure` column, taken unchanged from the census standard file (see each level's source documentation for definition and unit). Rows with missing values are dropped, so counties where a small-population estimate could not be computed have fewer rows than the full geography x year grid. Note that `acs_VAL` (median home value) is nominal dollars and not inflation-adjusted. The `acs_PCT_*` sex shares and age-band shares each sum to exactly 1 within a geography-year, but the seven race/ethnicity shares sum to slightly less (median 0.999, as low as 0.88) because non-Hispanic 'some other race alone' has no category of its own — do not treat the race shares as a complete partition. ACS and PEP shares are not interchangeable either: the two programs use different methodologies and race/ethnicity classifications, which is why `source` distinguishes them rather than the two being reconciled.

info.short_description: Census program the row's value came from. ACS 5-Year and PEP measure overlapping concepts with different methodologies and are reported side by side rather than reconciled.

info.long_name: Non-Hispanic Native Hawaiian and Other Pacific Islander Share of Total Population
info.short_description: Proportion of the population that is Non-Hispanic Native Hawaiian and Other Pacific Islander.
info.long_description: Share of the resident population identifying as Non-Hispanic Native Hawaiian and Other Pacific Islander alone, derived from ACS Table B03002.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is Non-Hispanic Native Hawaiian and Other Pacific Islander.

info.long_name: Non-Hispanic Two or More Races Share of Total Population
info.short_description: Proportion of the population identifying as Non-Hispanic two or more races.
info.long_description: Share of the resident population identifying as Non-Hispanic and of two or more races, derived from ACS Table B03002.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population identifies as Non-Hispanic two or more races.

info.short_description: Total county resident population from the Census Bureau's Population Estimates Program.
info.long_description: Annual postcensal population estimate for the county, summed from single-year-of-age counts in the Population Estimates Program (PEP) characteristics file. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_population measure.
info.statement: In {location}, the estimated population is {value}.

info.long_name: Percent of Population Age 65 and Older (PEP)
info.short_description: Share of county population age 65 or older.
info.long_description: Sum of single-year-of-age PEP population estimates for ages 65 and up, divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_65_and_older measure.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is age 65 or older.

info.short_description: Share of county population under age 18.
info.long_description: Sum of single-year-of-age PEP population estimates for ages 0-17, divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_below_18_years_of_age measure.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is under age 18.

info.long_name: Percent of Population that is Female (PEP)
info.short_description: Share of county population identified as female.
info.long_description: PEP population estimate for the 'Female' sex category, divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_female measure.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is female.

info.long_name: Percent of Population American Indian or Alaska Native Alone (PEP)
info.short_description: Share of county population identifying as American Indian or Alaska Native alone, of any Hispanic origin.
info.long_description: PEP population estimate for POPGROUP 006 (American Indian and Alaska Native alone), divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_american_indian_or_alaska_native measure.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is American Indian or Alaska Native.

info.short_description: Share of county population identifying as Asian alone, of any Hispanic origin.
info.long_description: PEP population estimate for POPGROUP 012 (Asian alone), divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_asian measure.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is Asian.

info.long_name: Percent of Population Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander Alone (PEP)
info.short_description: Share of county population identifying as Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander alone, of any Hispanic origin.
info.long_description: PEP population estimate for POPGROUP 050 (Native Hawaiian and Other Pacific Islander alone), divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_native_hawaiian_or_other_pacific_islander measure.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is Native Hawaiian or other Pacific Islander.

info.long_name: Percent of Population Black or African American Alone, Not Hispanic (PEP)
info.short_description: Share of county population identifying as Black or African American alone and not Hispanic or Latino.
info.long_description: PEP population estimate for POPGROUP 453 (Black or African American alone, not Hispanic or Latino), divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_non_hispanic_black measure.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is non-Hispanic Black.

info.long_name: Percent of Population White Alone, Not Hispanic (PEP)
info.short_description: Share of county population identifying as White alone and not Hispanic or Latino.
info.long_description: PEP population estimate for POPGROUP 451 (White alone, not Hispanic or Latino), divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_non_hispanic_white measure.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is non-Hispanic White.

info.long_name: Percent of Population Hispanic or Latino, Any Race (PEP)
info.short_description: Share of county population identifying as Hispanic or Latino, regardless of race.
info.long_description: PEP population estimate for the 'Hispanic or Latino' HISP category (any race), divided by total population. Intended as the Census-native input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_hispanic measure.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of the population is Hispanic or Latino.

bundle_demographics/dist/demographics_co.long_name: Value of the demographic measure identified by measure
bundle_demographics/dist/demographics_co.short_description: Value for the measure identified by the `measure` column. Units differ by measure: `acs_POP*` and `pep_population` are person counts, `acs_PCT_*` and `pep_pct_*` are proportions (0-1), `acs_AGE` is years, `acs_VAL` is dollars, and `acs_DEP`/`acs_REX` are ratios/index values.
bundle_demographics/dist/demographics_co.long_description: Value for the measure identified by the `measure` column, taken unchanged from the census standard file (see each level's source documentation for definition and unit). Rows with missing values are dropped, so counties where a small-population estimate could not be computed have fewer rows than the full geography x year grid. Note that `acs_VAL` (median home value) is nominal dollars and not inflation-adjusted. The `acs_PCT_*` sex shares and age-band shares each sum to exactly 1 within a geography-year, but the seven race/ethnicity shares sum to slightly less (median 0.999, as low as 0.88) because non-Hispanic 'some other race alone' has no category of its own — do not treat the race shares as a complete partition. ACS and PEP shares are not interchangeable either: the two programs use different methodologies and race/ethnicity classifications, which is why `source` distinguishes them rather than the two being reconciled.
